identity.name: Q Timex Reissue
identity.one_liner: The 2019 reissue of the 1979 Q Timex — a hand-wound mechanical with a Pepsi bezel and a woven stainless bracelet at under $200.

narrative.story: The Q Timex (1979) was Timex's first electronic/mechanical hybrid; the 2019 reissue is fully mechanical — a hand-wind movement with a Pepsi (red/blue) bidirectional bezel, a woven stainless-steel expansion bracelet, and a 38mm case that matches the original. The reissue was the surprise of 2019: a sub-$200 mechanical from a brand known for $40 quartz. The Q Timex is the most-cited affordable mechanical reissue and the watch a collector cites when they want 1970s design without the 1970s maintenance.
narrative.collector_notes: The 2019 Q Timex is hand-wind only (no automatic). The woven expansion bracelet is a stretch-link design from the 1970s.
